body:
Correction. The maintainer asked for a GUI test before any push of this work. No GUI test has happened yet, and no comment on this PR should claim one. (An earlier comment that claimed it was deleted; it also carried the ready flag, which was withdrawn, so the PR is a draft again.)

The PR is up because the branch and the draft PR are the work record. Nothing merges until the maintainer tests the build and the independent review is clean.

Reproducible readings on head 984b2af6: camcraft-ui lib suite 793 passed, report_tests 7, structural 10, op_icon_table 5, clippy 0 warnings, `cargo xtask icons --check` 0 breaches.

Test build: `.claude/worktrees/issue-1696/target/debug/camcraft-ui.exe`

Note for the reviewer: this PR touches `.github/`, so `pr-test.yml` refuses it and the review builds locally (read, not built: the yellow `needs-maintainer` path).

This comment gives the decision that the maintainer made for issue #1696 after this PR was opened. It changes no label and no state of this PR.

The decision (2026-11-17, issue #1696): "GitHub issue in browser".
- Send opens a new GitHub issue of this repository in the browser. The type, the title, the description and the program version are filled in.
- The program uploads nothing. It saves the screenshot and the log to a folder, opens that folder, and tells the user to drag the files into the issue.
- The project file is included only when the user sets the check box. The program then copies it to the same folder and does not upload it.
- The program stores no account data.

What this PR has, as an agent read it: a Report door beside Debug info, "Report a bug" and "Request a feature" with a prefilled issue URL, "Copy screenshot" to the clipboard, and the Debug info report in the body. This agrees with the first point of the decision.

What the agent did not find in this PR:
- The type selection Bug, Feature, Question.
- A description field.
- The check box for the project file.
- The check box for the log.
- A screenshot preview with "Retake screenshot".
- The step that saves the files to a folder and opens that folder.

If one of these items is in the PR, tell us and we correct this list. Your claim on #1696 stays live while this PR is open. No agent of this repository works #1696 during that time.
